Review Gather Town?

Reviewers mostly praise Gather Town as a virtual office that makes remote work feel more like being onsite: people can quickly “walk over” to teammates, start informal chats, host easy guest meetings, and make meetings feel less flat and more engaging than standard video calls. One founder, the maker of

Kai, echoes that daily use, saying it replaces calendar-heavy coordination with quick drop-ins. The main complaints are reliability issues, especially occasional voice-chat failures in meeting rooms and editing bugs that can cause changes not to save.
